summary: The registrant, BMO 2026-5C15 Mortgage Trust, filed a Form 8-K to report the contribution of a servicing shift lead note to a new securitization (BMO 2026-5C16), transferring servicing of The Landing Whole Loan to the new trust's pooling and servicing agreement. This is a routine administrative update in a CMBS transaction, not a special-situation corporate event. No merger, tender, activist, or strategic action is involved. The filing is standard under Item 1.01 and has no market-moving or risk-arb implications; simply monitoring for any servicing transfer issues is adequate.
